title: Transit Map — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Network gains a new connection
scenes.purpose: Show an idea joining an existing network as a transfer: existing routes draw, a new blue link draws by length, the System Central interchange seats at the crossing, then a marker travels the real blue segments to Network.
visuals: Fixed-orientation schematic map on light #F3F6F8 ground
Red horizontal route with Tools, Data, Teams, Services stops
Green vertical route with Feedback, Support stops
New blue route Idea → Sketch → Prototype → System Central → Users → Network
Capsule interchange symbol at the red/green/blue crossing
Caption card 'An idea becomes a connected system'

beats.development: Red and green routes draw by stroke length; ordinary-stop ticks and labels appear as each line passes them; caption card reveals with its copy.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: New blue connection draws from Idea; each station and its label appears only when the shaft reaches it; the interchange capsule seats with a short back-out as the link reaches the crossing.
'System Central' interchange label slides in and reads before any marker moves.
Marker travels by length along the actual blue segments, through the interchange, and arrives at Network; the terminus fills to mark the transfer arrival.
Settled hold of the completed connected system.

findings: Brisk 3 s flow: routes, link, interchange, marker in strict order with no dead time.
justifiedHolds: 0.3 s interchange read before marker departs (style rule: marker only after interchange reads).
0.3 s final settled hold for the full map and caption.

notes: Original network study, not factual route data.
